section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes a study conducted in Malaysia between May and September 2018, where trained researchers recruited adult participants of Malay or Chinese ethnicity from community settings such as parks, recreational areas, and markets. Participants completed a paper-and-pencil questionnaire in private stations after providing written informed consent, with the order of scales counterbalanced and demographic items presented last.
